newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB shares extend gains in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: NCB shares extend gains in afternoon.

text.p: Shares in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) extended gains on Thursday afternoon after an official of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party was quoted as saying on Wednesday that public money could be used to protect creditors holding bank debentures.
At 0505 GMT, the share was traded at 238 yen, up 34 yen, or 16.67 percent, making it the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Volume was 13.579 million shares, the heaviest on the first section.
